description: A rain-soaked poster advertising 'Pandora's Grand Travelling Carnivale & Curiosities - October 1988'. The clown's eyes have been scratched out with a rusted needle.
discoveredLore: Townsfolk reported children slipping out of their bedrooms at 3 AM following the sound of calliope music.

description: Page 42 of the pharmacist's log. Notes describe a patient suffering from intense waking nightmares of a scarlet balloon tapping against their 2nd floor window.
discoveredLore: The patient wrote in the margin: 'It doesn't burst. It whispers.'

description: A typed log from Detective Vance: 'Suspect claims he didn't run away. He said the sewer grates opened up and invited him in to escape the cold.'
discoveredLore: A bloody fingerprint marks the bottom of the folder: the fingerprint matches no human record.

description: A heavy cast iron valve wheel encrusted with dried salt and tallow. Inscribed around the rim: 'DEEP DERRY SEWERS - SANCTUARY OF SHADOWS'.
discoveredLore: Turning the valve in sequence 3-6-9 drains the primary canal leading to the Clown's Lair.
